sources.title: Hotel shift handover
sources.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
sources.article: The evening receptionist will hand over the booking records to the night team before leaving. Staff must follow up on guest requests that were not resolved during the day. A guest who needs an early taxi should receive a clear confirmation before the morning shift begins. The shared checklist shows who is responsible for each request, so guests do not need to explain the same problem again.

sources.title: Campus water study
sources.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
sources.article: A student research group will gather evidence about water use in two campus buildings. Before drawing a conclusion, the group must take into consideration the different numbers of people using each building. They will compare measurements from ordinary teaching weeks rather than holidays. Their report will explain the limits of the sample instead of claiming that one small study proves which building is always more efficient.

sources.title: Workshop safety planning
sources.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
sources.article: The workshop supervisor will carry out an inspection before a new machine is used. The team must comply with the safety rules, even when several orders are waiting. A short training session will show staff where to stop the machine and whom to contact if something goes wrong. The supervisor will ask a colleague to check that the written instructions match the controls on the machine.
